title: Fades
name: Fades
description: Stop fading clips one by one. Select your tracks and Fades puts the right fade on every clip at once: crossfades where clips touch, fade-ins and fade-outs on free edges, never more than 45 % of a clip. Drag the lengths, pick the shapes, save presets for vocals, drums or dialog, and undo it all in one go. Getting-started guide, 7 languages.
